ja: 人気のロボシリーズから“クルルロボMk-II”発進！！
クルルボール形態へ変形！
ロボに乗り込むクルル曹長も手足が可動。
クルル曹長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
en: From the popular Robo series, "Kururu Robo Mk-II" is launched! !
Transform into a crurule ball form!
Sergeant Kururu, who gets into the robot, also has movable limbs.
Sergeant Kururu can be placed on a saucer that can also be used as Robo's cockpit.
